contract: Group microphone uses the actual shared LiveMicrophone processing/device/profile controller with explicit private policy. Its separate manual intent and local deafen apply; unrelated guild server-mute/deafen and guild manual intent do not remotely toggle private capture. Initial private intent conservatively inherits current manual mute, then stays group-local.
Raw SDK microphone TrackToggle and duplicate RoomAudioRenderer are removed. Camera/share remain behind existing encrypted admission. SDK automatic audio/video/screen capture remains false.

Group audio owner mounts only after actual-owner E2EE ACK and authoritative current group epoch. Rekey/auth/room retirement tears down exact old microphone controller and output graphs. Main and group admission never directly re-enable old microphone tracks while controller disposal may be pending.

Another current guild/P2P call conservatively blocks group capture, without stopping or changing that call. Both synchronous controller latch and parent intent latch prevent auto-unmute if conflict ends, including rapid start/end before React commits. A new explicit group unmute is required. Receiving and camera behavior remain separate.

Group PTT uses the actual event.code preference (default Space); keyup, blur, hidden document, editable focus, shortcut capture, key change, conflict and auth retire release capture. Hidden/unfocused/typing/composing/repeated/defaultPrevented keydown is denied. No global Electron listeners or shortcut registration are touched.

Each exact borrowed remote audio track uses existing remote-only playback graph through neutral privatePlayback alias, with selected sink, explicit failure/retry and missing-device fallback, bounded master0..100 times personal0..200, local deafen/local person mute, separate screen-share gain. Guild moderation does not mute private output.

Output ownership binds auth generation, exact room/remote participant/publication/track and per-graph active token. Output changes close only old derived graphs; old participant events and delayed completion cannot affect replacement owners. Borrowed remote media tracks are never stopped.
